ledger.x: 14 February 1958: King Faisal II of Iraq and his cousin King Hussein of Jordan unite their kingdoms in the Arab Federation 'as a response to the formation of the United Arab Republic'; Nuri al-Said becomes 'Premier of the Arab Union'.
14 July 1958: Faisal II is deposed in the military coup of Abd al-Karim Qasim ('overthrow the government there in the 14 July Revolution'); Iraq leaves the federation in all but name.
2 August 1958: the new Iraqi government officially dissolves the federation (infobox 'Disestablished: 2 August 1958'); Jordan carries on as the Hashemite Kingdom.

wars.name: 14 July Revolution
wars.outcome: Qasim's troops overthrow the government in Baghdad on 14 July 1958 and the Iraqi government dissolves the federation on 2 August; not a war over borders, listed so the reviewer can see it was considered.

certainty.note: The two kingdoms' own frontiers were fixed; the union itself drew no border and is not coloured as territory.
